summary: Master the Digital Supply Chain Control Tower. Learn real-time visibility, predictive analytics, and SCOR alignment to optimize global logistics.
lede: Digital supply chain control tower training covers how to connect data and improve visibility across supply chains. For senior supply chain and logistics professionals, it builds practical skills in mapping data integrations, using predictive analytics for demand and risk signals, and simulating disruption scenarios with digital twins.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is tailored for senior professionals responsible for the strategic and operational performance of global value chains.
modules: Digital Supply Chain Evolution and SCOR Alignment
Control Tower Architecture and Data Integration
Predictive Analytics and AI-Driven Demand Sensing
Digital Twin Simulation and Scenario Planning
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations management. A working knowledge of ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle) and basic data analytics concepts is required. No coding or programming experience is necessary, as the focus is on strategic architecture and operational application.
